events.name: San Francisco Giants at Atlanta Braves
New York Mets at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Bo Bichette continued his hot streak with three hits, rookie Nolan McLean struck out nine in seven innings and the New York Mets averted being swept with a 9-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bichette has 3 hits, McLean strikes out 9 as Mets beat Reds 9-1 to avoid series sweep

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Luinder Avila took a shutout into the sixth, and the Kansas City Royals hit four solo homers in the first three innings of a 6-2 victory over the Washington Nationals on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Avila rebounds, taking a shutout into the 6th as the Royals beat Washington 6-2 to avoid a sweep

headlines.description: — Kyle Stowers homered twice and drove in five runs and the Miami Marlins avoided a series sweep with a 12-4 win over the Philadelphia Phillies on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stowers homers twice, drives in 5 runs to power the Marlins past the Phillies 12-4

headlines.description: — Jeremy Peña homered and had an RBI single, Peter Lambert allowed just one run on two hits and the Houston Astros beat the Detroit Tigers 4-2 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jeremy Peña homers, Lambert allows 2 hits and Astros beat Tigers 4-2

events.name: San Diego Padres at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Fernando Tatis Jr. and Jackson Merrill each drove in two runs and finished with three hits as the San Diego Padres avoided a series sweep with a 6-1 win over the St. Louis Cardinals on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tatis and Merrill combine for 4 RBIs as the Padres beat the Cardinals 6-1

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Freddie Freeman hit a go-ahead, two-run homer in the sixth inning after the Tampa Bay Rays scored four runs off a banged-up Shohei Ohtani in the Los Angeles Dodgers' 5-4 win on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman’s go-ahead 2-run homer rescues banged-up Ohtani in Dodgers' 5-4 win over Rays

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Corbin Carroll hit a grand slam, Eduardo Rodriguez earned his 100th career win on the mound and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Los Angeles Angels 8-1 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Corbin Carroll hits grand slam, E-Rod earns 100th win in D-backs' 8-1 victory over the Angels

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Andrés Giménez had two hits, an RBI and three steals, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. drove in two runs and Toronto beat the Boston Red Sox 3-0 on Wednesday night after the Blue Jays placed scheduled starter
headlines.shortLinkText: After placing scheduled starter Max Scherzer on injured list, Blue Jays beat Red Sox 3-0

events.name: Chicago White Sox at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Cody Bellinger hit an early homer and finished a triple shy of the cycle, Paul Goldschmidt homered for the third time in four games and the surging New York Yankees used another big inning to beat the Chicago White Sox 10-5 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bellinger and Goldschmidt homer as surging Yankees beat White Sox 10-5

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Christian Yelich and Jackson Chourio homered and the Milwaukee Brewers scored seven runs in the first four innings in a 9-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yelich and Chourio homer as the Brewers beat the Guardians 9-4

headlines.description: — Dansby Swanson and Pete Crow-Armstrong homered as the Chicago Cubs beat the Colorado Rockies 8-6 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cubs score 7 runs in the 2nd inning and get homers from Swanson and PCA in 8-6 win over Rockies

headlines.description: — Kyle Bradish struck out a career-high 12 while pitching one-run ball into the eighth inning as the Baltimore Orioles beat the Seattle Mariners 5-3 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Bradish strikes out career-best 12 as Orioles sink Mariners 5-3

headlines.description: — Ryan O'Hearn homered, doubled and singled to finish with a career-high six RBI as the Pittsburgh Pirates romped to a 12-4 victory Wednesday night over the Athletics.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan O'Hearn knocks in career-high 6 runs as Pirates roll to 12-4 victory over Athletics
